# Electronic Patient Record

> Open-source electronic patient record software: a safe, append-only, audited longitudinal patient record with FHIR R4 as both data model and API, and explainable patient identity matching. A Rust matcher library, a Rust service (loco.rs, PostgreSQL) and a SvelteKit 3 / Svelte 5 UI, specified in spec/. Pre-release scaffold (milestone M0): NOT FOR CLINICAL USE; do not enter real patient data; no accreditation, certification or clinical validation is claimed.

- The specification in spec/ and each project's spec/index.md is the source of truth; code and docs follow it. A behavioural change is one commit with a spec edit, a code edit and a test edit.
- One item, one commit, one push, then look at CI. Stage named files, never `git add -A`.
- Say plainly what is not built or not tested: every CHANGELOG.md entry states what was not done or not verified. Never weaken a guard or census test to get green.
- Clinical risk: a change that could alter what a clinician sees, decides or signs updates governance/clinical-safety/hazard-log.csv in the same commit. Never set a hazard to accepted or closed; only the Clinical Safety Officer does.
- The clinical record is append-only: no delete path for clinical data. Absent evidence is null with a reason, never zero; a missing field blocks an automatic patient link.
- API versioning is the Accepts-version request header on the unversioned /api path, never /api/v1. Use Podman, not Docker.
- Translations are machine-written until a speaker reviews them. Never claim a translation is reviewed.
- Never put real patient data in examples, tests or fixtures; use synthetic data.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/README.md): What the project is, the three subprojects, how to run the API from a fresh clone.
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/AGENTS.md): How work is done here: spec first, one commit per item, the gates, and the things that are easy to get wrong.
- [Specification index](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/index.md): Entry point to the specification.
- [Implementation status](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/14-implementation-status.md): Generated: exactly what is built and how many tests pass.
- [Tasks](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/tasks.md): The task queue with what landed, what is open and what was not verified.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Every change, newest first, each stating what was not done or not verified.

## Specification

- [Purpose and vision](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/01-purpose-and-vision.md): The problem and what this provides.
- [Scope](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/02-scope.md): What is in and out.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/05-domain-model.md): Entities and relationships.
- [Functional requirements](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/06-functional-requirements.md): Numbered functional requirements.
- [Non-functional requirements](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/07-non-functional-requirements.md): Safety, security, performance, accessibility.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/08-architecture.md): Components and data flow.
- [API surface](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/09-api-surface.md): Routes, versioning by header, error bodies.
- [Persistence](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/10-persistence.md): Append-only tables and audit triggers.
- [Testing strategy](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/11-testing-strategy.md): Gates, census tests, oracles.
- [Compliance](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/12-compliance.md): The regulatory position and what is not claimed.
- [Benchmark](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/benchmark.md): Where the repository stands against open-source EPR, EHR and FHIR systems.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/15-roadmap.md): Milestones M0 onward.
- [Open questions](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/spec/16-open-questions.md): Decisions that need a maintainer, a clinician or the Clinical Safety Officer.
- [Plan](https://github.com/electronic-patient-record/electronic-patient-record/blob/main/plan.md): The long plan behind the task queue.

## Commands

- matcher: `cd electronic-patient-record-matcher-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test`
- service: `cd electronic-patient-record-service-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test`
- service database tests: `TEST_DB_PORT=5543 TEST_REDIS_PORT=6390 podman compose -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait, then DATABASE_URL=postgres://loco:loco@localhost:5543/electronic_patient_record_test cargo test -- --ignored --test-threads=1`
- ui: `cd electronic-patient-record-ui-with-svelte && pnpm run check && pnpm exec vitest run && PW_PORT=4183 CI=true pnpm exec playwright test`
- docs: `python3 scripts/check-links.py . && sh scripts/generate-status.sh --check && python3 scripts/generate-llms.py --check && python3 scripts/check-hazard-log.py`
